lines.speaker: corvin_ashby
lines.text: The river steams, the soil chills, and everyone calls it weather. Forgive me. What did you want to ask?
lines.direction: Light, quick, a little anxious; precise educated words with warm, distracted curiosity.

lines.speaker: corvin_ashby
lines.text: The forge needs dry fuel and a proper draught. That will not cure the Vale, but it will let Tobin work without another shard.
lines.direction: Light, quick, a little anxious; precise educated words with warm, distracted curiosity.

lines.speaker: corvin_ashby
lines.text: Not enough to be certain. Try dry charcoal first. A modest experiment is better than a grand mistake.
lines.direction: Light, quick, a little anxious; precise educated words with warm, distracted curiosity.

lines.speaker: corvin_ashby
lines.text: Watch what changes. The waterline, the birds, the heat in a stone. Memory is useful; measurements are kinder to an argument.
lines.direction: Light, quick, a little anxious; precise educated words with warm, distracted curiosity.

lines.speaker: corvin_ashby
lines.text: If you find a warm stone where it should be cold, bring it. Carefully.
lines.direction: Light, quick, a little anxious; precise educated words with warm, distracted curiosity.

lines.speaker: corvin_ashby
lines.text: You found it. The ember. May I... no. No, don't hand it to me. I'd only want to know what it costs.

lines.speaker: corvin_ashby
lines.text: I've written down the bridge. All of it. Someone should, while we still remember it right.

lines.speaker: corvin_ashby
lines.text: Mother Skarrow's people remember things my ledgers don't. If you go up the hill again, ask them about the seven. Please.
